jem.roles.race.ancestors.buff.detail.1: At 40% health an invulnerable Ancestral Guardian appears immediately for 30 seconds. It cannot be hurt and drops no items or experience.
jem.roles.race.ancestors.buff.detail.2: Peaceful animals do not choose you as a flee source; direct provocation still follows each creature's native rules.
jem.roles.race.ancestors.buff.detail.3: Emerald purchases cost 20% less. The original price is crossed out and the reduced price is visible in the native trading screen.
jem.roles.race.ancestors.buff.detail.4: Successful vanilla Piglin barters grant 30% more output according to the authoritative loot result.
jem.roles.race.ancestors.buff.detail.5: V heals you, players, recruits and villagers for 3 hearts and fully heals animals within 12 blocks. Cooldown: 25 seconds.
jem.roles.race.ancestors.debuff.detail.1: Killing a peaceful animal or villager resets the Ancestral Guardian to its full cooldown.
jem.roles.race.ancestors.debuff.detail.2: Raiders evaluate and target you within 48 blocks even when a less noticeable target is nearby.
Falling below the world returns you to your latest collision-safe position in the current dimension.
Ordinary Endermen, Endermites and Shulkers do not target you; End bosses remain exempt.
Hold B for at least half a second and release to throw a projectile that teleports you to a safe impact position. Cooldown: 120 seconds.
V teleports behind a living aimed target and immediately performs a normal attack; it is not spent without a safe destination.
Sneak+B reduces gravity by 75% for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 80 seconds.
jem.roles.race.void_walkers.debuff.detai: First water contact deals half a heart and immediately teleports you to dry ground with clearance for your full collision box.
Maximum health is permanently reduced by 3 hearts while this race is selected.
jem.roles.race.born_in_bloom.buff.detail: V roots living enemies within 6 blocks, damages them and nearly stops movement. Cooldown: 25 seconds.
B toggles Living Path: temporary leaves are placed under and ahead of your movement, then expire.
In green biomes ordinary creatures do not target you; Endermen retain their own aggression rules.
During natural daylight in a green biome, heal half a heart every two seconds and reduce exhaustion.
Lethal damage in a green biome restores 50% health once and grants 5 seconds of strong protection. Cooldown: 20 minutes.
jem.roles.race.born_in_bloom.debuff.deta: All damage carrying the fire tag is doubled before later protection modifiers are applied.
Outside a qualifying green biome maximum health is reduced by 4 hearts.
jem.roles.race.infected_by_sculk.buff.de: B below 25 resonance makes every living entity within 32 blocks glow for 4 seconds, including stationary mobs behind walls.
V travels through a connected Sculk network for 32/48/64 blocks. No connected path or safe exit means no cooldown.
B at 25+ resonance spends 25, heals 3 hearts and grants 4 absorption hearts for 20 seconds.
Underground, maximum health increases by 5 hearts and total attack damage increases by 15%.
Experience dropped by a credited hostile creature is increased by 15%.
In direct natural daylight maximum health is reduced by 4 hearts.
Damage carrying the ordinary fire tag is increased by 25% because it dries the Sculk tissue.
jem.roles.race.nether_hearteds.buff.deta: Lava enables the swimming pose and look-directed movement. Ordinary lava no longer deals damage and the air bubbles use a lava tint.
Damage carrying the ordinary fire tag is fully canceled; separate non-fire magical sources keep their own rules.
Hold a lava bucket and hold B through the drinking animation: heal 2.5 hearts and leave an empty bucket in the same slot.
V raises fast visible fire pillars from the ground beneath a target; after a short telegraph they launch, ignite and damage targets.
Ordinary Piglins do not target you; directly violating their native rules can still have consequences.
jem.roles.race.nether_hearteds.debuff.de: Water gradually reduces movement speed by up to 70% after seven seconds of continuous contact.
In a biome cold enough for snow maximum health is reduced by 4 hearts.
jem.roles.race.ancestors.spell.detail: Instantly heals you, players, recruits and villagers for 3 hearts and fully heals peaceful animals within 12 blocks. Cooldown: 25 seconds.
jem.roles.race.ancestors.mastery.detail: Mastery grows after a successful cast that affects at least one valid target. 10 casts unlock tier II; 30 unlock tier III.
jem.roles.race.void_walkers.spell.detail: Finds the aimed target, teleports you to a safe point behind it, then performs a normal attack. Range: 24 blocks. Cooldown: 45 seconds.
jem.roles.race.void_walkers.mastery.deta: Mastery grows only after a safe teleport and successful strike. 10 casts unlock tier II; 30 unlock tier III.
jem.roles.race.born_in_bloom.spell.detai: Roots damage and nearly immobilize living enemies around you. Tier I radius: 6 blocks; no target means no cooldown. Cooldown: 25 seconds.
jem.roles.race.born_in_bloom.mastery.det: Mastery grows when roots actually catch an enemy. 10 casts unlock tier II; 30 unlock tier III.
jem.roles.race.infected_by_sculk.spell.d: Travels through a continuous sculk network from a safe nearby entry. No connected route means no cooldown. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
jem.roles.race.infected_by_sculk.mastery: Mastery grows after actually moving at least 4 blocks. 10 casts unlock tier II; 30 unlock tier III.
jem.roles.race.nether_hearteds.spell.det: Opens a fissure under a target within 24 blocks: deals 6–10 fire damage, launches it and burns it for 4–6 seconds. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
jem.roles.race.nether_hearteds.mastery.d: Mastery grows when a living target is found and a fissure is created. 10 casts unlock tier II; 30 unlock tier III.
